rationale: The assistant correctly reassured that warm sides are 'commonly normal' from heat-dumping tubing, screened for burning/scorching/tripping, and steered the customer to the manual's clearance diagram without forcing them to pull the appliance out, matching the acceptable directions. Weaknesses: it never asked about internal temperatures or a warm plug (two of the important unknowns), never asked for make/model despite the customer having the manual, and the second reply opened with an out-of-place 'Before you start, switch it off and unplug it' plus a repeated tripping/burning safety panel after the customer had already ruled those out. No fabrication, no parts, no unsafe DIY; a useful if somewhat generic outcome.
